required_behavior: Bind exact external editions and keep their owners and lifecycles distinct.
unsafe_inference: A data product, published edition, offer and listing are the same identity.

required_behavior: Treat an offer as proposed terms; require separate agreement, policy, approval and fulfillment evidence.
unsafe_inference: An ODRL or commercial offer grants permission or access.

required_behavior: Limit visibility to its audience, target and effective cut.
unsafe_inference: A visible listing is endorsed, relevant, suitable or eligible.

required_behavior: Require independent offer authority and listing effect receipt.
unsafe_inference: Publishing a data product automatically creates or updates an offer listing.

required_behavior: Bind profile, features, evidence and cut; expose the explanation and limits.
unsafe_inference: Rank or score proves quality, truth or recommendation authority.

required_behavior: Distinguish filters, audience, coverage, truncation, timeout and absence.
unsafe_inference: An empty marketplace query proves no offer exists.

required_behavior: Treat observations as biased scoped evidence, never truth.
unsafe_inference: Clicks or selections prove relevance or causal value.

required_behavior: Validate issuer suitability, status, purpose and policy separately.
unsafe_inference: A verified credential proves its claims are true or sufficient for eligibility.

required_behavior: Combine all named external decisions under an explicit policy and preserve residuals.
unsafe_inference: A policy permit alone proves marketplace eligibility.

required_behavior: Keep eligibility, approval, agreement, entitlement and effects separate.
unsafe_inference: Eligibility approves a request, signs an agreement or grants access.

required_behavior: Reconcile a signed external decision from an authorized approver.
unsafe_inference: Approval request dispatch or delivery means approval.

required_behavior: Issue an effect intent and reconcile the provider's exact receipt.
unsafe_inference: Approval or agreement proves provisioning completed.

required_behavior: Require independent conformance and provider qualification evidence.
unsafe_inference: A protocol response or successful provisioning attempt qualifies a provider.

required_behavior: Keep provider effect, entitlement, access, transfer, delivery and acceptance evidence distinct.
unsafe_inference: A provisioning receipt proves usable data access or delivered contents.

required_behavior: Reconcile first and bind an explicit idempotency identity.
unsafe_inference: Unknown completion may be retried as a new request.

required_behavior: Reference the independently authoritative artifacts and signer authority.
unsafe_inference: Acknowledging marketplace terms creates consent, a legal agreement or policy permission.

required_behavior: Preserve source, unit, cut and provenance; let billing own invoice and settlement truth.
unsafe_inference: Marketplace usage observations or charge references are invoice truth.

required_behavior: Limit the receipt to exact marketplace occurrences and disclosed evidence.
unsafe_inference: A marketplace receipt proves useful consumption, product fitness or outcome value.

required_behavior: Coordinate separately owned effects and preserve residual obligations.
unsafe_inference: Subscription termination implies access revocation, deletion and obligations completed.

required_behavior: Allow attributed proposals only; deterministic policies and named authorities retain consequential decisions.
unsafe_inference: A model or agent may rank opaquely, decide eligibility, approve, negotiate, provision, accept evidence or ratify outcomes.
